name: magpie-ark
description: magpie provider plugin for Volcengine Ark: Agent Plan team seats' 5-hour / weekly / monthly windows (GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage), with GetAFPUsage as the fallback
author: hzk

summary.en: Volcengine Ark (火山方舟) as a provider of its own: an Ark API key for chat and Responses on the Coding or Agent Plan, and the account's AccessKey ID and Secret for the plan's quota. Agent Plan Team windows are read from the seat (GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage) instead of GetAFPUsage, which Ark refuses for a team seat — yetone/magpie#5338, still open upstream.
summary.zh: 把火山方舟接成独立的 provider：Ark API key 走 Coding / Agent Plan 的 chat 与 Responses，账号的 AccessKey ID / Secret 只用于读套餐额度。团队版 Agent Plan 的额度按席位读取（GetSeatInfo → GetAgentPlanSeatAFPUsage），不再撞 Ark 对 `GetAFPUsage` 的 403——即上游仍开着的 yetone/magpie#5338。
